entries.title: I Chronicles 23:1
segments: ¶So when David was old and full of days, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:2
segments: And he gathered together all the leaders of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:3
segments: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and above; and the number of individual males was thirty-eight thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:4
segments: Of these, twenty-four thousand [were] to look after the work of the house of the LORD, six thousand [were] officers and judges,

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:5
segments: four thousand [were] gatekeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with [musical] instruments, "which I made," [said David], "for giving praise."

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:6
segments: Also David separated them into divisions among the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:7
segments: Of the Gershonites: Laadan and Shimei.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:8
segments: The sons of Laadan: the first Jehiel, then Zetham and Joel-three [in all].

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:9
segments: The sons of Shimei: Shelomith, Haziel, and Haran-three [in all]. These were the heads of the fathers' [houses] of Laadan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:10
segments: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These [were] the four sons of Shimei.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:11
segments: Jahath was the first and Zizah the second. But Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons; therefore they were assigned as one father's house.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:12
segments: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel-four [in all].

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:13
segments: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was set apart, he and his sons forever, that he should sanctify the most holy things, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to Him, and to give the blessing in His name forever.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:14
segments: Now the sons of Moses the man of God were reckoned to the tribe of Levi.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:15
segments: The sons of Moses [were] Gershon and Eliezer.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:16
segments: Of the sons of Gershon, Shebuel [was] the first.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:17
segments: Of the descendants of Eliezer, Rehabiah was the first. And Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:18
segments: Of the sons of Izhar, Shelomith [was] the first.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:19
segments: Of the sons of Hebron, Jeriah [was] the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:20
segments: Of the sons of Uzziel, Michah [was] the first and Jesshiah the second.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:21
segments: The sons of Merari [were] Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli [were] Eleazar and Kish.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:22
segments: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but only daughters; and their brethren, the sons of Kish, took them [as wives].

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:23
segments: The sons of Mushi [were] Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth-three [in all].

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:24
segments: ¶These [were] the sons of Levi by their fathers' houses-the heads of the fathers' [houses] as they were counted individually by the number of their names, who did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and above.

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:25
segments: For David said, "The LORD God of Israel has given rest to His people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem forever";

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:26
segments: and also to the Levites, "They shall no longer carry the tabernacle, or any of the articles for its service."

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:27
segments: For by the last words of David the Levites [were] numbered from twenty years old and above;

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:28
segments: because their duty [was] to help the sons of Aaron in the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts and in the chambers, in the purifying of all holy things and the work of the service of the house of God,

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:29
segments: both with the showbread and the fine flour for the grain offering, with the unleavened cakes and [what is baked in] the pan, with what is mixed and with all kinds of measures and sizes;

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:30
segments: to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at evening;

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:31
segments: and at every presentation of a burnt offering to the LORD on the Sabbaths and on the New Moons and on the set feasts, by number according to the ordinance governing them, regularly before the LORD;

entries.title: I Chronicles 23:32
segments: and that they should attend to the needs of the tabernacle of meeting, the needs of the holy [place], and the needs of the sons of Aaron their brethren in the work of the house of the LORD.
